title: Blush Framework admin theme tokens
description: What an admin theme changes: colors, fonts, type sizes, radii, and padding. Anything it leaves out is the Neutral theme's. Every color is light-dark(light, dark), or one color for both schemes.

backgroundImage.description: --background-image: none, or gradients (linear-gradient(), radial-gradient(), conic-gradient(), and their repeating- forms) written with colors, numbers, and the gradients' keywords; light-dark() inside for each scheme's colors.

backgroundSize.description: --background-size: auto, or one or two sizes in pixels or a percent, such as "20px 20px".

ui.description: --font-family-ui: font family names, first choice first, such as ["Karla", "sans-serif"]. Without a generic family at the end, the platform's own UI font is used.

display.description: --font-family-display: font family names, first choice first, such as ["Karla", "sans-serif"]. Without a generic family at the end, the platform's own UI font is used.

title.description: --font-family-title: font family names, first choice first, such as ["Karla", "sans-serif"]. Without a generic family at the end, the platform's own UI font is used.

fontFace.description: The fonts the theme ships, as @font-face has them: woff2 files inside the theme.

fontFamily.description: The family name the fontFamily tokens use, such as "Karla".

src.description: The .woff2 file, relative to the theme, such as "fonts/karla.woff2".

fontWeight.description: A weight, or a variable font's range of two, such as "200 800".

unicodeRange.description: The characters it covers, such as "U+0000-00FF, U+0131".
